title: Causal-TGAN
summary: Causal-TGAN is a research implementation of a causally-aware GAN for generating synthetic tabular data, using a Bayesian Gaussian mixture and causal graph structure learned via Tetrad. Its dataset preprocessing pipeline imports RDT's OneHotEncodingTransformer directly from the SDV-family rdt package to encode discrete columns.
